consent_subtitle: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 requires your explicit choice for each data purpose.
audio_notice_text: Please review and grant your permissions below. Consent for Clinical Intake and Document OCR are mandatory for today's OPD consultation.
consent_intake_desc: Enables voice and touch processing of your symptoms to construct a structured history for your doctor.
consent_ocr_desc: Enables optical scanning of prior test reports and prescription cards to extract medications and test trends.
consent_abdm_desc: Links your consultation summary to your official Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA).
consent_research_desc: Allows fully de-identified statistics to be used for hospital throughput research.
error_mandatory_consents: Consent for Clinical Intake and Document OCR are mandatory to proceed with OPD consultation.
